propositions: Removing compact-on-close to fix a 13m53s lock hold left stores with no automatic compaction trigger, causing event logs to grow unbounded until manual intervention.

A two-arm selection mechanism must choose tickets to fold based on either having no SNAPSHOT with at least one foldable event, or having foldable event count exceeding the threshold, to avoid selecting tickets whose excess events are all inside the compaction horizon.
A scheduled sweep in CI runs every 6 hours and reuses infrastructure from reconcile-bridge.yml, re-deriving fresh from origin/tickets on each run to avoid accumulation.

An operation-linked trigger on the close path spawns a detached out-of-band compactor via O(1) checks after the store lock is released, using a stamped advisory lock to prevent multiple concurrent workers, providing a floor for stores without CI and without local cron.

The compaction sweep must walk git history once per sweep and amortize it across all tickets, never holding the store write lock during read-only git log operations, to avoid recreating the per-ticket or per-event lock contention that characterizes bug 7084.
